items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: That's why we played. They used to play the music that we play now. Yeah. And we'd buck on the lake every Sunday.

ctx.x: One played trumpet and one used to play the bass. And Philly Ray used to play bass. We used to get on the lake and buck out there. The camps would be right there, side and side. We used to get there and blow at each other. Dixon Land.
You're talking about humpback Gallaty though. Yeah.

The Dixon Land man. That's why we played. They used to play the music that we play now. Yeah. And we'd buck on the lake every Sunday. We'd go out there on a Saturday night. That's where the money stopped. Start the raise and you know the price.
